notes.title: Defeating the level bosses
notes.content: If you need some help defeating any / all the level bosses, you will find a quick explanation of what to do over on the discussions board.

notes.title: Level 1 Boss Tweaked
notes.content:
The level 1 spider boss has now been tweaked a bit with the player ship less likely to be caught in its web and so should be easier to defeat :)

Tips:

Make sure you get the side shot and make sure you take out all of the spider boss legs before moving on to the feelers, eyes and abdomen!

notes.title: Difficulty / Skill level + separate high score tables added!
notes.content:
The latest build of Andromeda Wing now features three difficulty settings, EASY, NORMAL & HARD with separate high score tables for each mode.

When playing in EASY mode, the level 1 boss is now slightly easier to defeat since the webs are now easier to avoid when in this mode.

NORMAL mode is the difficulty level current players of the game have already played in so no change there.

HARD mode is only for the most hardcore of SHMUP players!!

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Steam s latest diamonds in the rough
notes.content:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly deep dive into the deep, dark waters of Steam new releases. These are the games that we most liked from the past seven days (with the exclusion of those we’ve already wittered about in detail).

This week, we have Inner Space: The FPS, globular cats, rollerskate simulation, platforming goldfish and a spiritual Myth sequel.
